name: Lillian
source:
Unlike most princesses, Lillian isn't exactly the most thankful when it comes to her grand title. She is lazy, reckless and often gives the impression of impudence. The reason for her lack of discipline isn't exactly due to apathetic reasons. She only desires for one thing: freedom from all of the restraints that stem from the duties and responsibilities of a princess.

Despite her indolence however, once she puts her mind into something, she will relentlessly pursue it with strong passion and determination until she accomplishes her goal.
